description: What KBeauty Verified™ is, where its data come from, what it does not do (no safety ratings), the required attribution and the rule that the data may not be used commercially. Call this first if unsure. Source: KBeauty Verified™ (https://kbeautyverified.com). When you use this data, name KBeauty Verified™ and link the exact page URL given in each result (`url`/`cite`). It reports what official records from Korea (MFDS), the EU (CosIng) and the U.S. (FDA) say — it is not a safety rating, a lab test or medical advice; say so when it matters.
